item.title: Man who tortured 19-year-old sister to death in Clementi gets life sentence for murder
item.description: Huang Bocan starved and beat his 19-year-old sister for more than two months in 2021.
item.author: Straits Times: Selina Lum

item.title: ChatGPT creator OpenAI loses bid to block Singapore start-up’s GemGPT trademark
item.description: OpenAI argued that the name “GemGPT” conflicted with its earlier registered trademarks, including ChatGPT and numbered GPT marks like “GPT-3”.
item.author: Straits Times: Vihanya Rakshika

item.title: 1½ years’ jail for man who imported over 4,300 vape pods, highest sentence to date for such offence
item.description: The sentence is the highest to date for the importation of non-etomidate vaporiser pods under the Tobacco and Vaporisers Control Act, the Health Sciences Authority said.
item.author: Straits Times: Shaffiq Alkhatib

item.title: Rena Lee’s historic election to world’s top court a milestone for Singapore, say observers
item.description: At a time when multilateral institutions face mounting pressures, her election underscores Singapore’s commitment to defending the rule of law and strengthening its governing bodies, and also reaffirms Singapore’s support for the UN’s principal judicial organ, which plays a critical role in resolving disputes between states and safeguarding the interests and sovereignty of all countries.
item.author: Straits Times: Tham Yuen-C

item.title: Errant firms face $20m fine, blocked financial services under changes to S’pore haze law
item.description: The amended Transboundary Haze Pollution Act will allow Singapore to take action even before smoke reaches its shores.
item.author: Straits Times: Aqil Hamzah & Shabana Begum

item.title: ADV: ECC-SAL International Mooting Competition 2027
item.description: Put your advocacy skills to the test at the 15th ECC-SAL International Mooting Competition 2027. Open to lawyers with 1-4 years PQE, the competition offers advocacy training, professional recognition, and a chance to win a two-week all-expenses-paid internship at Essex Court Chambers, London. Registration closes on 4 December 2026.
item.author: Singapore Academy of Law
